model_annotation: This donut chart displays data categorized by ambiguity levels, with two concentric rings representing different measures. The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)", shows four categories based on standard deviation values: "Std: 0.0" (a dark blue segment, 49.0%), "Std: 0.47" (a medium blue segment, 47.7%), "Std: 0.82" (a light blue segment, 7.0%), and "Std: 0.94" (a very light blue segment, 5.0%). The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)", displays three categories based on maximum ambiguity values: "Max: 1" (a light blue segment, 39.0%), "Max: 2" (a very light blue segment, 38.0%), and "Max: 3" (a pale blue segment, 14.2%). The chart includes a legend on the right that correlates the colors with their respective labels and values.
